title: FastAPI Inventory
description: Inventory manager with product CRUD and stock restocking.

techDetails.scope: Built while learning Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL from scratch through a YouTube playlist.
highlights: FastAPI REST API with Pydantic v2 validation and Swagger UI docs
PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy ORM for data modeling, sessions, and startup database seeding
React dashboard for inventory and stock management

title: SpringMart
description: E-commerce store with product CRUD and image uploads.

techDetails.scope: Built to apply what I learned about Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and Docker from a YouTube playlist.
techDetails.architecture: Java • Spring Boot • Spring Data JPA • Docker • React
highlights: Spring Boot REST API with JPQL multi-field search, pagination, and startup database seeding in H2
Spring Data JPA entity mappings and raw-byte image upload endpoints
Containerized backend with Docker connected to a React client

title: Student Management System
description: Console Java app for student records and performance reports.

techDetails.scope: My very first coding project. Built to learn Java and MySQL, using AI tools for the first time to guide me through the architecture from start to finish.
highlights: Layered console architecture separating business logic from database operations
MySQL queries via JDBC using parameterized PreparedStatements against SQL injection
SQL queries for student performance and grade distribution reports

title: wrkout
description: Minimal workout tracker for PPL splits and progressive overload.

techDetails.scope: Built during a low phase when I was dealing with Class 1 obesity, weighing 94 kg (207 lbs), and had just joined the gym. I designed it around my favorite PPL split to stay consistent, log workouts, and check off exercises. I used it to lose 30 kg (66 lbs) in 1 year.
highlights: Fast set logging with inline steppers and tactile feedback
Progressive overload and volume tracking for PPL splits
Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS)

credentials.notice: Password resets via Resend are disabled because the app runs on a free Vercel subdomain without a custom domain. Log in with the demo credentials below or register a free account.

title: Shreyan's Arc
description: Interactive DSA roadmap curating 58 problems across 17 patterns.

techDetails.scope: When starting DSA prep, I felt overwhelmed by endless questions and roadmaps. After comparing NeetCode's Blind 75 and Sean Prashad's list, I built a custom roadmap curating 58 high-yield problems across 17 patterns to practice without friction.
highlights: Interactive pan-and-zoom canvas to customize roadmap layout
Firebase Auth and Cloud Firestore to sync progress across devices
58 handpicked interview problems across 17 core DSA patterns
Direct LeetCode problem links for every question on the roadmap

title: J-Void
description: Distraction-free Java practice editor with no compiler.

techDetails.scope: I prefer clean, minimal software. I built J-Void because LeetCode's editor felt cluttered with features I didn't need, giving me a distraction-free in-browser space just for writing Java solutions.
highlights: Monaco code editor with automatic Allman brace formatting
Custom line bookmarking in the editor gutter for quick review
Direct LeetCode links aligned with Shreyan's Arc roadmap

title: WealthWise
description: Financial advisory platform with interactive calculators.

techDetails.scope: Built for my father to help him reach more clients. It lets prospective clients explore services and run investment calculations before meeting him, saving time for both sides and making consultations smoother.
highlights: Interactive calculators for Investment, Retirement, Education, and Marriage planning
Direct WhatsApp lead routing and customizable advisor branding
